• **AI Spotlight**: Big Tech backs Anthropic in fight against Trump administration

• **Security Alert**: New KadNap botnet hijacks ASUS routers to fuel cybercrime proxy network

• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
